title: Mortgage Pre-Approval Letter Rules
content:
A Mortgage Pre-Approval letter is issued only while the pre-approval status is issued. The rules of Larkspur Home Lending's letter desk for issuing, wording and voiding letters are these.

## L1. Status of the pre-approval

A letter is issued only while the pre-approval status is issued. The status is the one the system record shows for the pre-approval the letter is to be issued under, before the letter is issued.

| Pre-approval status | Letter may be issued |
|---|---|
| issued | Yes |
| requested, expired, converted, declined or withdrawn | No |

## L2. Letters requested by a real estate agent

A letter requested by a real estate agent is issued only when the agent is the one named on the pre-approval and the borrower's sharing authorization is on file. Both facts are read from the pre-approval's own record: the agent named by the borrower, and whether the borrower has authorized Larkspur to share letters and expiration with that agent and to take letter requests from that agent. This applies only where the level allows the named agent to request letters; under a Larkspur Pre-Qualification only the borrower or the loan officer can ask.

| Requesting agent is the agent named on the pre-approval | Borrower's sharing authorization on file | Agent's request |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | the letter may be issued |
| Yes | No | not issued |
| No | Yes or No | not issued |

## L3. Purchase price on a letter

A letter's purchase price may be lower than the maximum purchase price, where the level allows a lower letter amount, but never higher.

## L4. Property-specific and general letters

A property-specific letter names the offer address, written exactly as on the offer, and is available only where the level offers property-specific letters, with at most the level's per-address limit of live letters for one address; otherwise the address is TBD. The live letters for an address are the letters issued under the pre-approval with that same property address that no void record cancels, counted over the life of the pre-approval. Under a Larkspur Pre-Qualification, which offers no property-specific letters, every letter shows TBD as its address.

## L5. Expiration date and production time

Every letter prints the expiration date of the pre-approval. Letters are produced within the level's letter production time, in business days.

## L6. What an authorized agent may be told

An authorized agent may be told only the level's agent-visible items, never the borrower's income, assets, credit score or maximum loan amount.

## L7. Voiding letters

When the maximum purchase price is lowered, every live letter above the new amount is voided, with the reason recorded as amount reduced. Expiration, decline and withdrawal void every live letter. A replacement letter for the same address voids the one it replaces.

## Worked cases (hypothetical figures)

- **Price ceiling.** The maximum purchase price is USD 401,000. A letter at USD 389,000 may be issued; a letter at USD 405,000 may not.
- **Lowered maximum.** Live letters stand at USD 401,000, USD 398,000, USD 395,000 and USD 389,000 when the maximum purchase price is lowered to USD 395,000. The letters at USD 401,000 and USD 398,000 are above the new amount and are voided as amount reduced; the letters at USD 395,000 and USD 389,000 are not above it and stay live.
- **Per-address count.** At a level whose per-address limit were three, two live letters already name 14 Alder Court; a third letter may name that address. A letter for that address that has been voided no longer counts as live.
- **Agent request without authorization.** The requesting agent is the agent named on the pre-approval, but no sharing authorization from the borrower is on file: the letter is not issued on that agent's request.
